items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Bill Jennings made the arrangement... So we did the recording at Nola Studio... I worked out a deal for Bill to be on the recording date.

ctx.x: It's a funny thing how that expression got so popular, 'one more time.' And Bill Jennings made the arrangement, which made the arrangement so beautiful. Because he played the melody of 'April In Paris,' the little whine(?) thing going on, but he didn't do a whole lot of ad-libbing on it. Because there's nothing in the world greater than the melody. If a melody is good, you can play it. And that left... Even some of these popular songs, the melodies just live forever. That's still going on. And it really comes…
